objective: locked Qwen3.5 target plus official DFlash -> integrated PyTorch graph -> TorchAir AIR -> ATC OM -> Ascend 310P strict-greedy prompt inference with synchronized stage timing

target.target_dtype: FP16 approved experiment; not promoted without target accuracy evidence
target.ordinary_authority: target_top1 remains authoritative for every committed token
target.initial_state_policy: recompute committed prefixes; no cache commit/rollback claim

outputs.draft_top1: int64 [1,15] for the locked block_size=16 checkpoint

integrated_graph.block_semantics: row zero is the already committed anchor; target features end before the anchor; rows 1: are proposals

build.fail_fast_preflight: before checkpoint construction require a concrete 310P ATC SoC variant, executable ATC, the workspace-declared strict --require-atc/--require-device preflight and importable TorchAir; the built-in graph additionally requires torch_npu and an explicit NPU factory device; the preferred runtime requires a startable hash-locked AscendCL C++ runner, while the Python reference runtime requires pyACL
build.air_external_weights: retain and hash every exported payload beside the AIR until ATC completes
build.artifact_integrity: verify all AIR payload hashes before ATC and record the OM SHA-256

runtime_backend.preferred_executor: qwen35_dflash_acl_runner: native AscendCL C++ with one loaded OM, pinned host memory, persistent device buffers/datasets and one stream
runtime_backend.abi_binding: manifest-declared ordered names alias OM runtime tensor names by index
runtime_backend.device_identity: target_id, concrete product, device ID, CANN, driver, firmware and pyACL identity
runtime_backend.paired_config_gate: the C++ runner executes both modes in one process/model/device and alternates measurement order; the Python reference configs are byte-semantically identical except for ordinary_only true/false

order: ordinary-greedy and DFlash strict-greedy paired 3+10 in one loaded C++ process
orchestration.summary: prompt output text/token IDs, device/runtime/compiler identity, AIR/OM/report hashes, parity, prefill/decode/model-total/end-to-end distributions and median ratios
orchestration.failure_policy: never write a PASS summary unless every preceding build, identity, stability and parity gate passes

timing.synchronization: device synchronization immediately before and after every measured backend call
timing.prefill: one synchronized integrated-OM call, including first committed target token
timing.decode: sum of synchronized proposal and target-verification calls
timing.baseline: exactly 3 warmups plus 10 raw measurements per mode; preferred C++ path alternates ordinary and DFlash order in one loaded process

gates.build: non-empty AIR and OM plus hash-complete manifests
gates.runtime: no CPU fallback and concrete Ascend 310P identity
gates.ordinary_reference: same OM bundle, tokenizer, prompt, device and runtime identities in ordinary-greedy mode
gates.accuracy: zero final token-ID and EOS mismatch against the ordinary report
gates.stability: 10/10 measured repetitions return identical token IDs and stop reason

closed_runtime_comparison.policy: same device/model/gear/prompt tokens/output tokens and synchronized model-loop scope; median and p90 ratio thresholds must be explicitly approved before comparison

current_evidence_boundary: real locked FP16 checkpoint integrated PyTorch graph, C++ scheduler tests, fake-ACL production-source integration and Python orchestration regressions pass; the declared simulation-only profile still has no real CANN/AscendCL link, AIR, OM or Ascend 310P latency
